t: A mobile app builder where an AI Builder makes apps from a plain description.
steps: Find Thunkable and read the Education page.
Ask the vendor for the Education plan.
Ask about a data agreement before any student use.
Read the privacy policy and note the consent rule for students under 13.
Build one sample app in the browser.
Test the app on a phone or tablet.
Set a rule that students do not share personal details in public projects.
